verses.en: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.pt: E esta é a bênção com a qual abençoou Moisés homem de Deus aos filhos de Israel, antes que morresse.
verses.en_web: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.en_bbe: Now this is the blessing which Moses, the man of God, gave to the children of Israel before his death.

verses.en: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
verses.pt: E disse: O SENHOR veio de Sinai, E de Seir lhes iluminou; Resplandeceu do monte de Parã, E veio com dez mil santos: À sua direita a lei de fogo para eles.
verses.en_web: He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.
verses.en_bbe: He said, The Lord came from Sinai, dawning on them from Seir; shining out from Mount Paran, coming from Meribath Kadesh: from his right hand went flames of fire: his wrath made waste the peoples.

verses.en: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.
verses.pt: Ainda amou os povos; Todos seus santos em tua mão: Eles também se chegaram a teus pés: Receberam de teus ditos.
verses.en_web: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.
verses.en_bbe: All his holy ones are at his hand; they go at his feet; they are lifted up on his wings.

verses.en: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
verses.pt: Lei nos mandou Moisés, Herança à congregação de Jacó.
verses.en_web: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: Moses gave us a law, a heritage for the people of Jacob.

verses.en: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
verses.pt: E foi rei em Jesurum, quando se congregaram os chefes do povo com as tribos de Israel.
verses.en_web: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.
verses.en_bbe: And there was a king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel came together.

verses.en: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.
verses.pt: Viva Rúben, e não morra; sejam seus homens em número.
verses.en_web: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”
verses.en_bbe: Let life not death be Reuben's, let not the number of his men be small.

verses.en: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.
verses.pt: E esta bênção para Judá. Disse assim: Ouve, ó SENHOR, a voz de Judá, e leva-o ao seu povo; suas mãos lhe bastem, e tu sejas ajuda contra seus inimigos.
verses.en_web: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, Yahweh, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”
verses.en_bbe: And this is the blessing of Judah: he said, Give ear, O Lord, to the voice of Judah and make him one with his people: let your hands take up his cause, and be his help against his attackers.

verses.en: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
verses.pt: E a Levi disse: Teu Tumim e teu Urim, com teu bom homem ao qual tentaste em Massá, e lhe fizeste brigar nas águas da briga;
verses.en_web: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.
verses.en_bbe: And of Levi he said, Give your Thummim to Levi and let the Urim be with your loved one, whom you put to the test at Massah, with whom you were angry at the waters of Meribah;

verses.en: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
verses.pt: O que disse a seu pai e a sua mãe: Nunca os vi: nem conheceu a seus irmãos, nem conheceu a seus filhos; por isso eles guardarão as tuas palavras, e observarão o teu pacto.
verses.en_web: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.
verses.en_bbe: Who said of his father, Who is he? and of his mother, I have not seen her; he kept himself separate from his brothers and had no knowledge of his children: for they have given ear to your word and kept your agreement.

verses.en: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
verses.pt: Eles ensinarão teus juízos a Jacó, e tua lei a Israel; porão o incenso diante de ti, e holocaustos sobre o teu altar.
verses.en_web: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.
verses.en_bbe: They will be the teachers of your decisions to Jacob and of your law to Israel: the burning of perfumes before you will be their right, and the ordering of burned offerings on your altar.

verses.en: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
verses.pt: Abençoa, ó SENHOR, o que fizerem, e recebe com agrado a obra de suas mãos; fere os lombos de seus inimigos, e dos que lhe odiarem; para que nunca se levantem.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”
verses.en_bbe: Let your blessing, O Lord, be on his substance, may the work of his hands be pleasing to you: may those who take up arms against him and all who have hate for him, be wounded through the heart, never to be lifted up again.

verses.en: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the LORD shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
verses.pt: E a Benjamim disse: O amado do SENHOR habitará confiante próximo dele; Ele o cobrirá sempre, E entre seus ombros morará.
verses.en_web: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”
verses.en_bbe: And of Benjamin he said, Benjamin is the loved one of the Lord, he will be kept safe at all times; he will be covered by the Most High, resting between his arms.

verses.en: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
verses.pt: E a José disse: Bendita do SENHOR seja a sua terra, com as dádivas dos céus, com o orvalho, e com o abismo que jaz abaixo,
verses.en_web: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by Yahweh, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,
verses.en_bbe: And of Joseph he said, Let the blessing of the Lord be on his land; for the good things of heaven on high, and the deep waters flowing under the earth,

verses.en: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
verses.pt: com excelentes frutos do sol, e com os excelentes produtos de cada lua,
verses.en_web: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,
verses.en_bbe: And the good things of the fruits of the sun, and the good things of the growth of the moons,

verses.en: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
verses.pt: e com o que há de mais excelente dos montes antigos, e com os excelentes produtos das colinas eternas,
verses.en_web: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,
verses.en_bbe: And the chief things of the oldest mountains, and the good things of the eternal hills,

verses.en: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.
verses.pt: e com os excelentes produtos da terra e sua plenitude; e que a benevolência daquele que habitou na sarça venha sobre a cabeça de José, e sobre ao topo da cabeça do que foi separado dos seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.
verses.en_bbe: The good things of the earth and all its wealth, the good pleasure of him who was seen in the burning tree: may they come on the head of Joseph, on the head of him who was prince among his brothers.

verses.en: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.
verses.pt: Ele é preeminente como o primogênito de seu touro, e suas pontas, chifres de boi selvagem; com eles chifrará os povos juntamente até os confins da terra; e estes são as dezenas de milhares de Efraim, e estes os milhares de Manassés.
verses.en_web: The firstborn of his herd, majesty is his. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples, to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”
verses.en_bbe: He is a young ox, glory is his; his horns are the horns of the mountain ox, with which all peoples will be wounded, even to the ends of the earth: they are the ten thousands of Ephraim and the thousands of Manasseh.

verses.en: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
verses.pt: E a Zebulom disse: Alegra-te, Zebulom, quando saíres; e tu Issacar, em tuas tendas.
verses.en_web: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.
verses.en_bbe: And of Zebulun he said, Be glad, Zebulun, in your going out; and, Issachar, in your tents.

verses.en: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.
verses.pt: Eles chamarão os povos ao monte; ali oferecerão sacrifícios de justiça; porque sugarão a abundância dos mares, e os tesouros escondidos da areia.
verses.en_web: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”
verses.en_bbe: They will send out the word for the people to come to the mountain, taking there the offerings of righteousness: for the store of the seas will be theirs, and the secret wealth of the sand.

verses.en: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
verses.pt: E a Gade disse: Bendito o que fez alargar a Gade: Como leão habitará, e arrebatará braço e testa.
verses.en_web: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm, yes, the crown of the head.
verses.en_bbe: Of Gad he said, A blessing be on him who makes wide the limits of Gad: he takes his rest like a she-lion, taking for himself the arm and the crown of the head.

verses.en: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.
verses.pt: E ele se proveu da primeira parte, porque ali uma porção do legislador foi-lhe reservada, e veio na dianteira do povo; executará a justiça do SENHOR, e seus juízos com Israel.
verses.en_web: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion reserved was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of Yahweh, His ordinances with Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: He kept for himself the first part, for his was the ruler's right: he put in force the righteousness of the Lord, and his decisions for Israel.

verses.en: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
verses.pt: E a Dã disse: Dã é um leão jovem; saltará desde Basã.
verses.en_web: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”
verses.en_bbe: And of Dan he said, Dan is a young lion, springing out from Bashan.

verses.en: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.
verses.pt: E a Naftali disse: Naftali, saciado de benevolência, e cheio da bênção do SENHOR, possui o ocidente e o sul,
verses.en_web: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of Yahweh’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”
verses.en_bbe: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, made glad with grace and full of the blessing of the Lord: the sea and its fishes will be his.

verses.en: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.pt: E a Aser disse: Bendito seja Aser em filhos; agradável será aos seus irmãos, e molhará em azeite o seu pé.
verses.en_web: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.en_bbe: And of Asher he said, Let Asher have the blessing of children; may he be pleasing to his brothers, and let his foot be wet with oil.

verses.en: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.
verses.pt: ferro e bronze será o teu calçado, e tua força será como os teus dias.
verses.en_web: Your bars will be iron and brass. As your days, so your strength will be.
verses.en_bbe: Your shoes will be iron and brass; and as your days, so may your work be.

verses.en: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
verses.pt: Não há como o Deus de Jesurum, montado sobre os céus para tua ajuda, e sobre as nuvens com sua grandeza.
verses.en_web: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
verses.en_bbe: No other is like the God of Jeshurun, coming on the heavens to your help, and letting his glory be seen in the skies.

verses.en: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
verses.pt: O eterno Deus é o teu refúgio, e abaixo os braços eternos; ele expulsará de diante de ti o inimigo, e dirá: Destrói.
verses.en_web: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
verses.en_bbe: The God of your fathers is your safe resting-place, and under you are his eternal arms: driving out the forces of your haters from before you, he said, Let destruction overtake them.

verses.en: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
verses.pt: E Israel, fonte de Jacó, habitará confiante sozinho na terra do grão e do vinho; também seus céus destilarão orvalho.
verses.en_web: Israel dwells in safety; the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.
verses.en_bbe: And Israel is living in peace, the fountain of Jacob by himself, in a land of grain and wine, with dew dropping from the heavens.

verses.en: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado és tu, ó Israel! Quem é como tu, povo salvo pelo SENHOR, o escudo de teu socorro, e a espada da tua excelência? Por isso os teus inimigos serão subjugados, e tu pisarás sobre as suas alturas.
verses.en_web: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”
verses.en_bbe: Happy are you, O Israel: who is like you, a people whose saviour is the Lord, whose help is your cover, whose sword is your strength! All those who are against you will put themselves under your rule, and your feet will be planted on their high places.
